actual_scope: Exact convolution admission for two phase-weighted Fourier read layouts and an independently weighted positive-sign inverse; shared conjugate routine as a restricted corollary.
scope_change_reason: Refines the all-size transfer card to the source-permutation cancellation obligation, extending PR940 from permutations to monomial layouts and affine shifts.
bottleneck_link: Side-result admission boundary: prevents unpriced phase/address changes from being treated as a valid retained Fourier interface. Does not change the binding complex supplier or its budget.
stop_rule: Prove or falsify the stated criterion, then exhaust the declared small-group census; no optimization or enlarged search. Reserve final 15 minutes of a 60 minute session for verification and handoff.
evidence: README.md gives the all-group monomial normal form and shared-conjugate rigidity proof. EXPECTED.json binds 357184 reduced candidates, 22688 shared-routine candidates, 10662 direct basis pairs, 1136 mismatched-address witnesses and nine semantic controls. test_verify.py adds an unreduced 32768-case two-point domain and source/failure controls.
author: Hanson Sun (@bbMisk), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in derivation, implementation, verification and prose. No independent human review or proof-assistant check.
